name: How does AI impact traditional SEO content strategy?
description: AI shifts SEO from keywords to user intent and contextual relevance, emphasizing high-quality, comprehensive content for better rankings.

mainEntity.name: How does AI impact traditional SEO content strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI significantly transforms traditional SEO by shifting focus from keyword stuffing to understanding complex user intent and contextual relevance. AI-powered search engines are better at interpreting natural language queries and evaluating content quality, E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness). This means content strategies must prioritize comprehensive, well-structured, and genuinely helpful information over simple keyword matching, making AI a critical component for modern SEO success.
